newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks mixed in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks mixed in London trading.

text.p: Japanese shares were mixed in London on Thursday, with some interest in small cap shares even as blue-chip export stocks were hit by yen strength against the dollar, dealers said.

The Nikkei 50 index of shares in London rose 2.59 points to 1,602.93. Earlier the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo shed 123.41 points or 0.60 percent to 20,488.15, as profit-taking after three consecutive days of gains weighed on the market.
"It has been quiet but there was some interest in small caps," one trader said, adding that shares in carmakers Nissan, Toyota and Honda were traded more actively.
Nissan rose 4 yen from the Tokyo close to 821 yen while Honda added 20 yen to 3540. Toyota gained 42.5 to 3,452.5.
Computer giant NEC Corp fell 5 yen to 1,645 yen, responding to a slip in the dollar after talk that the government was poised to set steps to stimulate the economy.
